review:
The next Rocket Eruption game, now on 4,096 ways in a tropical jungle. New ideas include multiplier rewards based on how many spins you've played, a special reel that triggers bonuses, and a free spins pre-game.

A special symbol that pays anywhere switches on its reel and lights a fire in the beast's mouth below. Medium-high volatility with a 6,030x max and the bonus about once every 250 spins. The RTP is a lower 94.15%, so enjoy it in demo.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
